bounded_question: How do the two sibling Find-family hosts (host A 0x609d0e0, host B 0x60bedc0) and the merge driver 0x609c8c0 drive the already-pinned Find pipeline (find_e70 0x6099e70, no_equals 0x609ba30, kind_dispatch 0x609b700, walker 0x609bcb0, matcher 0x60bb9a0, worker 0x6097630), and what does each report when the name cannot be resolved?

0x60bea8c.role: Host B catch: std::exception -> code 4 'Error parsing <name>:<what>'.

literals.value: basic_string: construction from null is not valid

open_unknowns: The '; ' literal host A writes into the copied value's name (code low byte 0) is an open unknown: the worker parses ';'-separated options, so it likely means 'no options', but the binary gives no gloss; the model records the literal and the branch faithfully.

Host A's find_e70 tail writes its Status into a local that is then discarded (only the message is freed); the call survives only through its side effects via the descriptor's slot 0x28 / delegate_impl. Modelled literally and pinned by test.
The worker's prefix is the string at element+0x20 (the matcher's prefix argument); the element's +0x00 name string is the scan's key. The model takes the +0x20 string as the prefix.
The seven enum maps live in .bss (runtime-built); the model takes them as harness-injected EnumMap objects, not binary reads.
The global default name at 0x6508980: its runtime contents are set by static init and were not located (carried from #3440); the model takes 'default' as the documented assumption.
The delegate vtable base is not pinned; the model holds the delegate's slots as callables supplied by the harness.
The serializer 0x60ba600 per-kind rules (25 jump-table cases) are a boundary; the default model reports every kind as serialized.
Which construction paths install a non-null +0x28 delegate is not pinned.
stod is modelled with Python float() on ordinary decimal inputs; inf/nan/hex-float edge inputs differ from C strtod.
The rehash excerpt may end with undecodable padding bytes at 0x5d3833a-0x5d3833c; verify.py's raw-bytes check confirms the excerpt matches the binary.

0x5d35070.name: shared_release
0x5d35070.role: Shared-control release tail (re-shipped from #3488): dispose through vtable slot 0x10, then decrement the weak count at +0x0c (locked xadd when __libc_single_threaded is 0); when the old weak count was 1, destroy through slot 0x18.

0x5d350c0.name: counted_release
0x5d350c0.role: shared_ptr control release: counts == 0x100000001 -> dispose via vtable slot 0x10 then destroy via slot 0x18; else atomic decrement of the use count (locked xadd when __libc_single_threaded is 0), and when the old use count was 1 the 0x5d35070 tail runs.

0x5d38260.name: rehash
0x5d38260.role: Hash-table rehash: new bucket array, same-bucket nodes re-linked contiguously in old-list order; count 1 takes the inline-bucket path; count>>60 throws bad_array_new_length.

0x5d5b300.name: map_clear
0x5d5b300.role: Options-map clear (re-shipped from #3488): destroy both strings of every node, sized-delete each 0x50-byte node, zero the buckets, first node and element count.

0x5e33fb0.name: value_dtor
0x5e33fb0.role: Value-struct destroy (re-shipped from #3485): release the +0x48 control through counted_release 0x5d350c0 and free the name string's heap buffer. Modelled as Value.destroy.

0x607d9f0.name: cstr_ctor
0x607d9f0.role: std::string ctor from const char*: SSO at 15 chars or fewer (length-1 fast path), heap via _M_create above; null throws logic_error via 0x963298. Second instantiation of the same template as 0x60b7d80.

0x607e020.name: options_list_destroy
0x607e020.role: Recursive linked-list destroy: +0x18 links walked unrolled 8 deep then recursed; each 0x28-byte node freed after its +0x10 child is freed as a 0x28 node; free order is the chain reversed, each node followed by its child subtree.

0x6080b10.name: find_plain_table
0x6080b10.role: PlainTableOptions host: delegate slot 0x38 resolves the options struct; the factory name takes the create path, other names take no_equals or the code-1 error.

0x60818f0.name: find_block_table
0x60818f0.role: BlockTableOptions host: same skeleton as the plain host with the 0xf8-byte defaults and the 0x260-byte creator; the defaults' owned sub-objects are released after the creator.

0x60956f0.name: zero_stub
0x60956f0.role: Default vtable slot-0x40 implementation (re-shipped from #3488): zeroes the 16-byte Status.

0x6095b80.name: node_clone
0x6095b80.role: Options-map node clone: allocates a 0x50-byte node and deep-copies the key and value strings; +0x40/+0x48 are NOT copied (the caller writes the hash).

0x6096f40.name: element_scan
0x6096f40.role: Element-vector scan (re-shipped from #3488): walks the 0x30-byte elements; per element the name lookup runs on the element's +0x28 table; returns the lookup result and stores the element's +0x20 field into found_out.

0x6097110.name: delegate_impl
0x6097110.role: Delegate implementation (re-shipped from #3488): calls the object's vtable slot 0x48 with (out, obj, value, ctx_map, flag).

0x6097150.name: fallback_delegate
0x6097150.role: Fallback delegate wrapper (re-shipped from #3488): calls delegate_impl with flag 0.

0x60971c0.name: resolver
0x60971c0.role: Name resolver (re-shipped from #3485): the name object's slot-0x60 string as-is, unless it contains '=' -- then '{' + the part before '=' + '}'.

0x6098510.name: worker_wrapper
0x6098510.role: Worker wrapper: empties the options string, then calls the worker 0x6097630 with an empty prefix string and the emptied options string as the accumulator.

0x6098ad0.name: find_by_element_scan
0x6098ad0.role: Element-scan host: element_scan over the table vector; exact match or kind 0x13 takes the matcher, kinds 0x15/0x16 take the delegate slot-0x10 virtual, other kinds are the code-1 error.

0x6099ce0.name: options_record_append
0x6099ce0.role: Append a 0x30-byte record {name string, options pointer, global} to the vector at obj+0x08 (begin/end/capacity), growing it when end == capacity.

0x6099e70.name: find_e70
0x6099e70.role: The '=' / ';' helper (re-shipped from #3488): parse path into a fresh map + delegate_impl slot 0x48 on success; otherwise slot 0x40 vs the zero stub 0x60956f0; then the value +0x03 byte gates slot 0x28.

0x609a1b0.name: map_find_name
0x609a1b0.role: Options-map find by name: count <= 0x14 walks the list (length, then memcmp), otherwise the hash-bucket walk (_Hash_bytes seed 0xc70f6907, stored hash at node+0x48). Returns the node or null.

0x609a2f0.name: map_erase_next
0x609a2f0.role: Options-map erase by node: unlink from the hash bucket, free the two strings (+0x38, +0x18, SSO-checked) and the 0x50-byte node, decrement the element count, return the next node.

0x609a410.name: find_norm
0x609a410.role: Find normalizer (re-shipped from #3485): empty/default name takes the fallback; no '=' returns the name; else parse, 'id' lookup/erase, fallback handling.

0x609a740.name: entry
0x609a740.role: Sibling Find entry point (re-shipped from #3488): flag-chain node resolution, value copy, name dispatch (exact name, id, .id variants, find_norm path, no_equals path). One direct call site (0x609b80f inside kind_dispatch).

0x609b700.name: kind_dispatch
0x609b700.role: Kind dispatch (re-shipped from #3488): kind 0x16 recurses into the entry; equal names or kind 0x13/0x15 take the node's slot-0x50; any other kind is code 1 'Could not find option: ' + str_b.

0x609b8a0.name: resolve_no_equals
0x609b8a0.role: No-'=' path (re-shipped from #3488): slot-0x68 fills the search name, element_scan runs, a null result is code 1 'Could not find option: ' + key6, otherwise kind_dispatch runs.

0x609ba30.name: no_equals
0x609ba30.role: No-'=' wrapper (re-shipped from #3488): forwards to resolve_no_equals 0x609b8a0.

0x609bad0.name: map_insert
0x609bad0.role: Local name-set insert: _Prime_rehash_policy check (0x5e52800 when needed), hash stored at node+0x28, node inserted after the bucket's before-begin node (list head for an empty bucket), count incremented. Called only from the walker.

0x609bcb0.name: resolve_all_elements
0x609bcb0.role: Registry walker: walks the registry map through slot-0x68 + name_lookup + kind_dispatch; code 1 advances, code 3 inserts the name into a local name set, other codes erase; the sweep phase erases the collected names; the final Status follows the value's +0x00 word bytes and the accumulated families.

0x609c8c0.name: merge_driver
0x609c8c0.role: Merge driver: clones the source options map first-wins per bucket, walks the descriptor's entries through the walker, merges survivors into arg7 when present, else reports the first surviving clone as 'Could not find option: '.

0x609d08e.name: host_a_cleanup
0x609d08e.role: Host A landing pad: destroys the local value, frees the out message and the accumulator, then _Unwind_Resume.

0x609d0e0.name: host_a
0x609d0e0.role: Find host A: the empty-map slot-0x28 path, the '; ' worker-wrapper path, the merge-driver call, and the post-driver slot-0x28 / find_e70-0x0101 tail (whose Status is discarded).

0x60b79b0.name: clear_string
0x60b79b0.role: string._M_replace(0, size, cstr, strlen(cstr)): the string is assigned the C string.

0x60b7cd0.name: range_ctor
0x60b7cd0.role: String range ctor: builds a string from [first, last); SSO up to 15 bytes, else heap _M_create + memcpy, NUL-terminated.

0x60b7d80.name: cstr_ctor_sibling
0x60b7d80.role: std::string ctor from const char* (re-shipped from #3485): the same template as 0x607d9f0; the two excerpts differ only in branch-target addresses.

0x60b84b0.name: hash_name_find
0x60b84b0.role: Hash-bucket name find (re-shipped from #3488): _Hash_bytes(key, len, 0xc70f6907) % bucket count, chain walked comparing stored hash, length, memcmp.

0x60b9d70.name: value_copy
0x60b9d70.role: Value-struct copy (re-shipped from #3485): deep-copy the 0x50 bytes (name string, the 16 bytes at +0x38, the +0x48 control with its use-count incremented). Modelled as Value.copy.

0x60ba0b0.name: name_lookup
0x60ba0b0.role: Name lookup (re-shipped from #3488): count <= 20 linear walk, else the hash-bucket find; exact match move-assigns the key into out; on a miss the '.' split with a kind 0x13/0x15/0x16 prefix match move-assigns the suffix.

0x60bb9a0.name: matcher
0x60bb9a0.role: Kind-0x15/0x16 matcher (re-shipped from #3485): null prefix or node state 4 zeroes out; the 0x2000 flag is code 3 'Cannot serialize option: ' + name (msg1 = the name); a non-null node+0x38 takes the virtual slot 0x40; kinds 0x16/0x15 take the resolver paths; other kinds take the serializer path (boundary).

0x60be160.name: enum_60be160
0x60be160.role: Enum lookup (u8): linear walk at size <= 20, else the _Hash_bytes walk; map 0x65070a0.

0x60be7f0.name: enum_60be7f0
0x60be7f0.role: Enum lookup (u32): the one u32 lookup -- reads/writes a full u32 at +0x28; map 0x6507020.

0x60bea8c.name: host_b_catch
0x60bea8c.role: Host B landing pad: cleanup, then selector 1 catches std::exception and reports code 4 'Error parsing <name>:<what>' via the status builder.

0x60bedc0.name: host_b
0x60bedc0.role: Find host B: the kind switch on desc+0xa8 (jump table 0x9786b4, 25 entries) over the nine text parsers, the seven enum lookups, the hex decode, the string assign, the 0x15/0x16 flag/link path and the code-3/code-4 reports.

0x60c1190.name: parser
0x60c1190.role: Options parser (re-shipped from #3485): brace stripping, key=value loop over delimiters '={};', duplicate keys overwritten; errors 'Mismatched key value pair, '=' expected', 'Unexpected char in key', 'Empty key found', 'Mismatched curly braces for nested options', 'Unexpected chars after nested options'.

0x60db710.name: block_ctor
0x60db710.role: BlockTableOptions ctor (boundary): sub-constructors 0x60db1e0/0x60d7fb0/0x60d6fd0, mutex init 0x60d50c0, options_record_append (name = the options struct's leading string, global 0x6507540) and 0x5db8800; vtables 0x64d39a8/0x64d3a70/0x64c9c60/0x64c9a40; throws on map::at.

0x6193a00.name: plain_ctor
0x6193a00.role: PlainTableOptions ctor: zeroes +0x08/+0x10/+0x18, installs vtable 0x64d6628, copies the 0x28-byte options struct into +0x20..+0x47, appends the record {name PlainTableOptions, obj+0x20, global 0x6508260}.

0x61c7fc0.name: hex_decode
0x61c7fc0.role: Hex decode: odd input length or a null out -> False; an invalid digit -> False with out left partially filled; success -> True.

0x61cf610.name: cstr_dup
0x61cf610.role: strdup-like: strlen+1, new char[], __strncpy_chk, pointer stored into *(out); returns out.

0x61cf670.name: status_builder
0x61cf670.role: Status builder (re-shipped from #3488): writes msg1 + ': ' + msg2 into the 16-byte Status; both message literals already end in ': ', so the binary genuinely reports doubled separators (e.g. 'Could not find option: : foo').

0x61d0ee0.name: escape_decoder
0x61d0ee0.role: Escape decoder: 'r' -> 13, 'n' -> 10, anything else -> the character itself.

0x61d10a0.name: escape_assign
0x61d10a0.role: Escape-assign: unescapes src into out; '\\' + char appends the decoded char, a trailing lone '\\' is dropped.

0x61d1390.name: ends_with
0x61d1390.role: Suffix check (re-shipped from #3488): 1 when the suffix fits and the haystack's last bytes equal it, else 0; an empty suffix returns 1.

0x61d13e0.name: str_compare
0x61d13e0.role: Lexicographic string compare (re-shipped from #3488): memcmp over the shorter length, else the signed length difference clamped to int32.

0x61d1480.name: bool_parser
0x61d1480.role: Bool parser: 'true' -> 1, 'false' -> 0, '1' -> 1, '0' -> 0; anything else throws invalid_argument built from the first argument.

0x61d1540.name: stoull_parser
0x61d1540.role: stoull parser (__isoc23_strtoull, base 10): no digits -> invalid_argument('stoull'); ERANGE -> out_of_range('stoull'); suffix T/G/M/K shifts by 40/30/20/10.

0x61d17d0.name: u8_parser
0x61d17d0.role: u8 parser: stoull, then (value >> 8) == 0 or the shared stub throws out_of_range with the input text as the message.

0x61d1840.name: u32_parser
0x61d1840.role: u32 parser: stoull, then (value >> 32) == 0 or the shared stub throws out_of_range with the input text as the message.

0x61d18a0.name: stoll_parser
0x61d18a0.role: stoll parser (__isoc23_strtoll, base 10): instruction-identical to stoull except the conversion and the literal; same T/G/M/K suffix shifts.

0x61d1b30.name: i32_parser
0x61d1b30.role: i32-via-stoll parser: stoll, then (value + 0x80000000) >> 32 == 0 or the shared stub throws out_of_range with the input text as the message.

0x61d1b90.name: stoi_parser
0x61d1b90.role: stoi parser (__isoc23_strtol): range check before the suffix shift; G/M/K shift by 30/20/10 with 32-bit wrap; T/t shifts by NOTHING.

0x61d1e30.name: stod_parser
0x61d1e30.role: stod parser (strtod): no digits -> invalid_argument('stod'); ERANGE -> out_of_range('stod'); no suffix handling; trailing content ignored.

0x61d1ef0.name: stoull_alias
0x61d1ef0.role: stoull alias: two instructions -- endbr64; jmp 0x61d1540.
